updates.title: 2 Denial of Service Vulnerabilities Patched in Azure Active Directory
updates.summary: Microsoft released patches for CVE-2026-50652 and CVE-2026-50653, two denial-of-service vulnerabilities affecting Azure Active Directory. Admins should review and apply these updates to protect their identity infrastructure from potential service disruptions.

updates.title: 5 Denial of Service Vulnerabilities Patched in Active Directory Federation Services
updates.summary: Microsoft patched CVE-2026-50304, CVE-2026-50368, CVE-2026-50324, CVE-2026-50355, CVE-2026-50411, and CVE-2026-50647 affecting Windows Active Directory Federation Services. These denial-of-service flaws could impact federated authentication; admins managing ADFS deployments should prioritize patching to maintain service availability.

updates.title: New SOC Identity Responder Role in Microsoft Entra
updates.summary: A new built-in Entra role called SOC Identity Responder enables security operations teams to perform identity containment actions from Microsoft Defender without requiring broad administrative privileges. This least-privilege approach reduces incident response delays by eliminating the need for SOC analysts to hold multiple high-privilege roles.

updates.title: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery Generally Available
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Backup and Recovery is now fully available, automatically backing up critical directory objects including users, groups, applications, Conditional Access policies, and authentication settings. This built-in protection helps admins restore tenants after accidental or malicious changes without manual intervention.

updates.title: Extended Conditional Access Protections for AI Agent User Accounts
updates.summary: Conditional Access now supports targeting and protecting AI agent user accounts with custom security attributes, agent-specific risk policies, and compliance requirements. This capability allows admins to apply fine-grained access controls to service principals and managed identities acting as agents.

updates.title: Direct Assignment of External Users to Access Packages
updates.summary: Entitlement Management now allows admins to directly assign external users to access packages by email without requiring pre-existing directory entries. External users are automatically invited as guests and governed through Entra ID Governance, streamlining partner and contractor access provisioning.

updates.title: BYOD Support for Windows Devices with Entra Registration
updates.summary: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) support for Windows is now generally available, allowing users and partners to securely access corporate resources from personal devices registered with Entra. Admins can assign traffic profiles to internal and guest users, simplifying remote work scenarios.

updates.title: Jailbreak and Root Detection in Microsoft Authenticator
updates.summary: Microsoft Authenticator now detects and blocks jailbroken or rooted devices from using work or school accounts by default. Users must move to compliant devices to continue using the app for corporate authentication, enhancing security posture for organizations with sensitive data.

updates.title: Domainless SAML IdP Federation for Workforce Tenants
updates.summary: Domainless SAML federation removes the requirement for domain matching between user email and preconfigured IdP domains during sign-in. External users can now authenticate using their IdP-managed credentials regardless of email domain, simplifying B2B federation setup.

updates.title: SCIM 2.0 APIs Now Available in US Gov Cloud
updates.summary: SCIM 2.0 APIs for managing users and groups in Microsoft Entra are now generally available in US Government cloud environments. Admins and developers can now use standards-based identity lifecycle management in sovereign cloud deployments.

updates.title: AD Group Enforcement for Entra Cloud Sync
updates.summary: Entra Cloud Sync now supports AD group enforcement, restricting modifications to designated Active Directory groups so changes can only be made through the Entra provisioning service. This prevents drift and maintains consistency between Entra and on-premises AD groups.

updates.title: DLP External Email Restriction for Microsoft 365 Copilot
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP now prevents Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing external emails in real time. This control helps organizations mitigate data risks and prompt injection attacks by blocking Copilot's access to unvetted external email content.

updates.title: DLP Protection for External Web Search in Copilot
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP expanded to prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches. This real-time control reduces data leakage risk by blocking Copilot from exposing protected information during web search interactions.

updates.title: DLP Sensitivity Label Restrictions for Copilot Across All Storage Locations
updates.summary: The DLP policy restricting Microsoft 365 Copilot from processing files with sensitivity labels now applies universally regardless of storage location. This enhancement ensures consistent data protection across Word, Excel, PowerPoint and all file locations.

updates.title: DLP Event Data Now Available in Defender Graph API
updates.summary: Microsoft enriched the Defender Graph API with DLP event data, enabling easier integration with SIEM tools and automated workflows. Admins can now export correlated alert and DLP rule-match data for centralized security monitoring.

updates.title: DLP Network Layer Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview DLP integrates with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access to filter sensitive files at the network layer. This enables organizations to intercept and block sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud applications, AI platforms, and content-sharing services before they leave the network.

updates.title: AI-Powered DLP Policy Optimizer
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview's new DLP Policy Optimizer uses AI to analyze policies, rules, and activity patterns to identify overlapping rules, redundancies, and misconfigurations. The tool provides prioritized recommendations to reduce false positives, noise, and complexity in DLP policy management.

updates.title: DLP Rule Actions for Power Automate Workflows
updates.summary: DLP policies now support triggering custom Power Automate workflows as an action when a rule is violated. This enables organizations to automate incident response, ticketing, and notification workflows directly from DLP policy matches.

updates.title: SharePoint and OneDrive Auto-Labeling Capacity Increase
updates.summary: Microsoft increased the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This enables organizations to label and protect significantly more data at rest, closing labeling gaps and preparing data for Copilot with greater confidence.

updates.title: Data Security Triage Agent Enhancements in Insider Risk Management
updates.summary: The Insider Risk Management Triage Agent now provides improved user risk summaries and activity explorer patterns to support better investigation accuracy and decision quality. These enhancements help analysts quickly contextualize and evaluate potential insider threats.
